description: A warm, classically styled residential front entry facade photographed in the soft golden light of autumn. The exterior wall is faced in light cream-painted or natural buff-colored brick with visible mortar joints in a running bond pattern. The doorway is framed by a graceful round arch in contrasting warm red-orange brick, creating a striking arched opening. The arched entry door is a tall multi-pane French-style door with a classic grid of glass lites in a matte black painted wood or steel frame. To the right of the arched door, vertical corrugated or fluted black metal cladding panels cover the building's side face, providing a bold modern contrast to the traditional brick. The soffit above the entry shows exposed natural pine or fir wood planking in a honey tone. In the background at the upper right, autumn-colored deciduous trees with orange and rust foliage are visible against a soft sky. A warm amber glow emanates from an elaborate traditionally styled wall-mounted lantern bracket mounted to the brick wall left of the door, its ornate cage casting warm light outward and downward onto the brick face. Camera is at a standing eye-level, approximately 5–6 feet, shooting an off-center composition placing the wall bracket and brick facade on the left and the arched door on the right.
